statement: On the fixed side-16 exact nonaliased R-153 p:2p strict-past and single fresh-4p twelve-dimensional conditional fibre with unit retained regulator multipliers and positive floor, the exact Pauli-Fierz split, Fourier resonance cancellation, floor-uniform radial correction bounds and direct source-coordinate harmonic coercivity give K_owner(g)[alpha,alpha] >= P_tilde(G)|alpha|^2. The unique global minimum lies in 70<G_*<71 and satisfies P_tilde(G_*) >= -332863942666997/439505584128000 = -4/5 + 18740524635403/439505584128000 > -4/5. Hence the owner plus explicit source Hessian is strictly above 1/10 and the scoped R-164 reduction may take rho=3/20, with full semiconvexity 31/220 and epsilon_v=367/880. Exact two-harmonic arithmetic also proves that the coefficient-one direct lemma does not tensorize to simultaneous fresh-4p and fresh-8p support; this does not refute the original single-pair theorem.
